newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 9.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Five senior officials of provincial agricultural association arrested for alleged vote-buying in recent elections of directors and supervisors
Taiwan may appoint incumbent representative to Holland Kuo Wei-fan as new head of its office in France
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Five held for alleged involvement in bribery scandal over recent elections of farmer association's directors and supervisors
Harvard professor Michael Porter urges local industries to keep roots in Taiwan
LIBERTY TIMES - Five arrested for alleged vote-buying in farmer associations' elections
State-run Chunghwa Telecom to cut mobile phone, international call rates
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan to maintain ban on telephone call-back service
Central bank said to maintain "stable-to-loose but not-too-loose" money policy
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Securities and Exchange Commission warns investment and trust companies against involvement in management rights of listed firms
China announces names of six Chinese shippers to operate direct cross-strait shipping business
